name: Hagino Akito
source:
A detective employed in the High-Tech Investigation Division.

Though he is as honest and kind as one who’s never learned to distrust others, he is incredibly athletic, and dives into danger without a second thought whenever the occasion calls for it.

[Taken from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/4822170/view/683017363938871435]Steam[/url]]
